description: Checks a landlord's CAM / operating expense reconciliation (true-up) line by line against the commercial lease: pro-rata share, CAM caps, admin and management fees, excluded costs (capital repairs, landlord overhead and more), gross-up, totals and late delivery. Pass the full text of the lease (with amendments) and of the reconciliation, as you read them from the user's files; mark page breaks as '--- page N ---' so citations point to the right page. HTTPS links to the PDFs also work. Returns a request id: call get_audit_result after about 3 minutes. If you cannot read the files, tell the user to forward them to audit@tenantback.com instead.

contact_email.description: Work email of the tenant the documents belong to. Their free workspace and report are tied to it.

lease_text.description: Full text of the lease and any amendments

property_name.description: Store, center or property name, for the user's reference

statement_text.description: Full text of the landlord's reconciliation statement

name: audit_cam_reconciliation
title: Audit a CAM reconciliation against the lease
